descriptions.text: A fake Ledger Live app on the official Microsoft App Store which was resulted in 16.8+ BTC ($588K) stolen.

A fake 'Ledger Live Web3' application was published in the Microsoft Store in late October 2023. Users who entered their recovery phrases in the app had their BTC and ETH wallets drained, resulting in $768,000 in losses. Microsoft removed the fraudulent app after public disclosure. Microsoft Store's app review allowed a fraudulent application to impersonate Ledger Live. Users who trusted the app and entered seed phrases had their credentials harvested and funds stolen. No technical flaw in Ledger or Ledger Live was exploited.
